independence_declaration.statement: domain-reviewer authored no DG3 implementation, test, register row or ADR in the reviewed candidate, including the round-6 repair T-DG3-KBE-H (commit 53ac073, merged in a5c4f5e). I formed this verdict from my own runs in a complete (non-shallow) disposable clone of source commit c40232b. I re-used my round-3 to round-5 probes (dg3-api, dg3-api-extra, dg3-ui-world, dg3-ui, dg3-ui-inherited, dg3-ui-overflow, dg3-ui-overflow-r3) byte-for-byte; in the shell harness I changed only the round label, the evidence path and the clone path. I read the repair diff only to understand the change. I did not open any other reviewer's round-6 record or evidence.

checks_run.command: sha256sum docs/delivery/assignments/DG3/round-6/domain-reviewer.md; git rev-parse HEAD; git merge-base --is-ancestor c40232b HEAD; git diff --name-only c40232b HEAD; node tools/gates/candidate.mjs --stage DG3 (repo and clone); git clone /home/user/My-owns $TMPDIR/review-dom6 && git checkout c40232b; git rev-parse --is-shallow-repository
checks_run.environment: Repository /home/user/My-owns at HEAD 36411df; clone $TMPDIR/review-dom6 at c40232b01b7ec3cbf24759617bc645847a517a7e; Node 24.21.0.
checks_run.expected: Assignment sha256 d5785e4b…; candidate sha256:7049d793…, 757 files, in both the repository and a non-shallow clone of c40232b.
checks_run.actual: The assignment hash matches. HEAD is 36411df, the round-6 freeze commit, which is a descendant of c40232b. It changes only delivery metadata (3 assignments, the candidate manifest, progress.md and stages.json), all excluded from the manifest. The repository and the non-shallow clone both give sha256:7049d793cd20ed7718e84ff4aa3bf940f99b5e2507e964660ef3b3545c1f3c96 with 757 files. After the runs the clone held my untracked rv/ probe copies (7 .mjs files), which give 764 files and a different hash. After I removed rv/, the clone gave 7049d793… with 757 files again and a clean git status. The candidate is unchanged by my runs.

checks_run.procedure: In the clone, run typecheck, build, lint, the unit tests (pnpm test: unit-node + unit-web, then unit-formula-nocodegen) and the contrast check, on Node 22 and on Node 24.
checks_run.environment: Disposable clone at c40232b. node_modules copied with cp -a from the working tree; pnpm-lock.yaml is byte-identical to both the clone's lockfile and node_modules/.pnpm/lock.yaml. Node 22.22.2 and 24.21.0; offline sandbox.
checks_run.expected: Every step exits 0 on both Node versions. The new ESLint rules accept the unchanged engine sources.
checks_run.actual: Typecheck, build, lint (eslint . --max-warnings=0, including the new KBE-H selectors), test and contrast all exit 0 on Node 22 and on Node 24. Tests: unit-node + unit-web give 81 files and 1651 passed. unit-formula-nocodegen gives 3 files, 256 passed and 2 skipped (258). Disclosures: (1) The 2 skips are both it.skipIf(NOCODEGEN) in fuzz.test.ts. They are the two ESLint tests, which cannot run under --disallow-code-generation-from-strings because ESLint's ajv compiles schemas with new Function. Both ran and passed in unit-node on both Node versions: 'every file of the engine's import closure gets the engine-source lint rules' and the new 'ESLint refuses the round-5 handler forms (G1, G2, A1, A2), F1 and the round-4 forms'. Round 5 had 1 such skip; the second is the new round-6 test, skipped by design in the same way. (2) A grep for FAIL/✗/× finds 4 lines per log. All are the '×' character in passing test names ('role × month grid', EN and AR), not failures. (3) The build log has Vite's chunk-size advisory ('Adjust chunk size limit…'), a warning that doesn't fail the build, as in earlier rounds. (4) The contrast log lists three 'fails' lines under 'Prohibited combinations (must fail; never used by the UI)'. That is the check's intended negative list, including white on #0078FF at 4.09:1, and the script exits 0.

checks_run.procedure: Inspect git diff 21e2742e..c40232b outside docs/delivery and classify every changed file. Confirm that no engine source, API, web, DB, shared-schema or i18n file changed. Check that the rewritten ADR-0024 §6 claims no more than it delivers.

The list of non-test files under apps/ and packages/ is EMPTY: no engine source (tokenize/parse/typecheck/evaluate/value) changed, and no API, DB, shared-schema, web or i18n file changed. The non-delivery commits in 21e2742e..c40232b are only 53ac073 (T-DG3-KBE-H) and its merge a5c4f5e. The rest are review evidence and delivery records. The rewritten §6 now ends with an explicit 'Residual' paragraph ('Two gaps remain, and this section claims nothing beyond them'). It claims no coverage figure, so there is no over-claim. The seeded results are unchanged on the live stack (DOM-R6-07): attach rate 0.10->0.12 × 100000 × ARPU 50 SAR = '100000' exact (rounding.exact '100000', rounded false; the delta is the 0.02 fraction_delta); the cost example eligible_volume × (baseline_unit_cost − target_unit_cost) = 500000 exact; monthly ARPU × annual population = 422 formula.period_mismatch, while the explicit to_period conversion gives 200.

G1 stays draft with 0 gate_submission and 0 gate_decision rows. End-to-End is all null and inherited approval is refused. A waiver never approves anything.

The annotation is pending_verification with counts false, then accepted/true, accepted with unverified evidence/false, re-verified/true, revoked/false, and rejected/false. The KBE-H repair changes only eslint.config.js (two new selectors for engine sources), fuzz.test.ts, ADR-0024 §6 (now with an explicit residual) and p3-work-split amendment 28. No engine source, API, web, DB or i18n file changed, so formula semantics are unchanged: 100000 SAR exact, the cost example gives 500000, and monthly × annual is refused. F-DG3-120 still holds (33/33 API, 94/94 UI: the annotation states and counts are correct, and G1 stays draft with no decision). F-DG3-170 still holds (12/12 and 155/155: the badge wraps inside its card and row in EN and AR). The full domain probes match round 5 exactly (API 139/139, UI 42/42, the same ids). Unit tests pass on Node 22 and 24 (1651 + 256 passed; 2 by-design NOCODEGEN skips of ESLint tests that pass in unit-node), the targeted integration suites pass (156), and all three validators pass. No new finding.
